-- ============================================================
-- test-09-requires_pos.fh  –  requires PASS-Tests (REQ-01..08)
-- ============================================================
module Test.Requires.Pos

import Test.Support exposing Point, make_point

-- REQ-01: Einfache requires
function positive(n: Integer) returns Integer
requires n > 0
ensures result > 0
is
    return n
end positive

-- REQ-01 EDGE: Grenzwert exakt 1 (kleinster erlaubter Wert)
function min_positive() returns Integer
ensures result > 0
is
    return positive(1)
end min_positive

-- REQ-02: Mehrere Bedingungen
function bounded(n: Integer, lo: Integer, hi: Integer) returns Integer
requires n >= lo, n <= hi, lo <= hi
ensures result >= lo, result <= hi
is
    return n
end bounded

-- REQ-03: Feldzugriff in requires
function get_x(p: Point) returns Integer
requires p.x >= 0, p.y >= 0
ensures result >= 0
is
    return p.x
end get_x

-- REQ-04: Bibliotheksaufruf in requires
function require_sku(sku: String) returns String
requires String.instr(sku, "SKU") >= 0
ensures String.instr(result, "SKU") >= 0
is
    return sku
end require_sku

-- REQ-04 EDGE: leerer Suchstring
function require_nonempty(s: String) returns String
requires String.instr(s, "") = 0
is
    return s
end require_nonempty

-- REQ-07: Redundante Bedingungen (beide korrekt)
function redundant(seed: Integer) returns Integer
requires seed > 0, seed >= 1
ensures result > 0
is
    return seed
end redundant

-- REQ-08: requires mit and / or
function requires_and(a: Integer, b: Integer) returns Integer
requires a > 0 and b > 0
ensures result > 0
is
    return a + b
end requires_and

function requires_or(a: Integer, b: Integer) returns Integer
requires a > 0 or b > 0
ensures result >= 0
is
    if a > 0 then
        return a
    end if
    return b
end requires_or

end Test.Requires.Pos
